summary.scope: Four matched6.25ms spatial fields, independent linear-model discrepancy, exact continuum geometry qualification and paired CAD/polyhedron meshes

spatial.scope: Compare complete spatial fields at one unchanged time with saved-state or recovery provenance.
spatial.limitations: One matched physical time with fixed original physical inputs and complete independently reconstructed1e-9N body/mapped force gates. Completed source histories may have different requested lengths outside the common saved window; a recovered finest state requires its explicit independent recovery audit. Neither mode establishes a new complete80-step trajectory comparison. Lumped support areas are quadrature diagnostics, not independently resolved physical contact boundaries. All raw peaks and common physical points remain visible. Whole histories, credible spatial/contact/geometry tails, application/model/feedback and verified warmed costs remain incomplete.

linearization.scope: Separate resolved-load linearization from frozen-deformation constitutive differences on matched states.
linearization.limitations: One matched state per mesh at the explicitly recorded physical time and unresolved spatial/contact settings. Replaying resolved full-inertia loads through independent linear FEM measures a combined finite-geometry/constitutive linearization discrepancy; the reference-wrench balance correction is explicit. Frozen-objective-deformation stress comparison diagnoses the constitutive assumption without claiming a new equilibrium solve. Rigid-relief comparison is not a corresponding solved rigid/deformable feedback case. Native numerical replay, physical convergence, full histories, remaining finite-footprint models and verified warmed cost remain separate requirements.

continuum_geometry.scope: Measure egg CAD approximation independently of elasticity and fixed-polyhedron contact refinement.
continuum_geometry.limitations: Geometry-only measurements keep every actual source mesh and its material/density unchanged. Radial deficits compare facet centroids with the analytic surface at the same height; they are not normal-distance or Hausdorff bounds. Volume/mass differences do not attribute a fraction of stress error or prove nonlinear contact singularity. Fixed-polyhedron local refinement and CAD approximation remain distinct. Stress/contact/feedback and physically verified accuracy/cost acceptance remain required.

paired_mesh_geometry.scope: Build matched-connectivity CAD and fixed-polyhedron egg meshes without changing material or density.
paired_mesh_geometry.limitations: These are separate declared geometry-model families at fixed density and material. CAD refinement changes represented volume/mass; the polyhedron branch preserves the original boundaries and integrals. Connectivity matching does not isolate every contact or FEM discretization error. Initializer diagnostics compare physical P2 node positions only; they do not authorize changing supports or actuation. Actual reference-contact solves must preserve compatible physical anchors or explicitly qualify a common initializer. No stress, contact-history, physical convergence or warmed-cost acceptance follows from these geometry assets.

summary.scope: Check native numerical recovery separately from matched nonlinear-reference model differences.
summary.limitations: One matched32.5ms state per mesh at unresolved physical spatial/contact settings. This is actual production Quadrants recovery of independently resolved nodal loads. Same-discretization linear numerical error and finite-geometry/constitutive model discrepancy are reported separately. Full-inertia and rigid-relief loads define separate problems; neither establishes actual rigid/deformable feedback, finite-footprint load-model accuracy, physical convergence or warmed cost at verified accuracy.

figure.caption: At6.25ms, four independently checked fixed-polyhedron egg states retain growing raw global stress and substantial adjacent tensor/energy changes. (a) Vertical segments show lower/upper nonlinear whole-volume peak bounds, with independent resolved-load linear peaks. (b) Adjacent common-point tensor and energy changes remain above the declared initial3% engineering target. (c) Resolved-load and frozen-objective tensor discrepancies quantify two distinct linear-model diagnostics. (d) A separate matched-connectivity geometry study retains the original12.79% volume/mass deficit for polyhedral refinement; CAD approximation reduces it to0.219% at30720 tetrahedra. Material/density are fixed and represented mass is reported, not retuned. Deterministic states and bounds carry no statistical uncertainty. These diagnostic sequences do not establish converged contact physics, the full original application or verified accuracy/cost.
figure.body_interpretation: The finest fixed-polyhedron pair changes tensor/energy by15.52%/9.35%, while its resolved-load linear tensor discrepancy reaches11.22%. CAD geometry error decreases on a distinct sequence, so geometry accuracy cannot be inferred from the fixed-polyhedron stress sweep. The densest contact and stress regions remain unresolved; this figure contains no sampled contact-area boundary or fitted singularity order.

limitations: One matched6.25ms state on four fixed-polyhedron meshes retains15.52% tensor/9.35% energy changes,3.79–5.94GPa raw peak bounds and11.22% resolved-load linear tensor discrepancy at30298 tetrahedra. Exact geometry checks separate the12.79% original mass deficit from CAD approximation, which decreases to0.219% on30720-tet paired geometry assets. Increased native iterations recover original complete force gates but retain failures of the unchanged strict cached-corner field comparison. Failed startup attempts remain visible. New actual CAD/polyhedron contact references are live and excluded. Original histories, credible physical/contact/geometry tails, models/feedback and warmed costs at verified accuracy remain open. JSON files above200MB are preserved as exact ordered32MiB byte ranges, individually gzip-compressed, with original/part/stored SHA256 and offsets. Join decompressed ranges in index order to restore the original JSON exactly; no records are reduced or excluded. Runtime staging uses hard links for unchanged small originals.
